chunks.arabic_text: بِاسْنَادِهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْيَقْطِينِيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Via his chain to Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqtini who said:

chunks.arabic_text: بَعَثَ إِلَيَّ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ رَزْمَ ثِيَابٍ وَغِلْمَانًا وَحَجَّةً لِي وَحَجَّةً لِأَخِي مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ وَحَجَّةً لِيُونِسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَحُجَّ عَنْهُ فَكَانَتْ بَيْنَنَا مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ أَثْلَاثًا فِيمَا بَيْنَنَا فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَعْبِيَ الثِّيَابَ رَأَيْتُ فِي أَضْلاَعِ الثِّيَابِ طِينًا فَقُلْتُ لِلرَّسُولِ مَا هَذَا فَقَالَ لَيْسَ يُوجَهُ بِمَتَاعٍ إِلَّا جُعِلَ فِيهِ طِينٌ مِنْ قَبْرِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ ثُمَّ قَالَ الرَّسُولُ قَالَ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ هُوَ أَمَانٌ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَأَمَرَنَا بِالْمَالِ بِأُمُورٍ مِنْ صِلَةِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَقَوْمٍ مُحَاوِجٍ لَا يُؤْبَهُ لَهُمْ وَأَمَرَ بِدَفْعِ ثَلَاثَمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ إِلَى رَحِمِ امْرَأَةٍ كَانَتْ لَهُ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُطَلِّقَهَا عَنْهُ وَأُمَتِّعَهَا بِهَذَا الْمَالِ وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَشْهَدَ عَلَى طَلَاقِهَا صَفْوَانُ بْنُ يَحْيَى وَآخَرُ نَسِيَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى اسْمَهُ

translations.en: Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (peace be upon him) sent me a bundle of clothes, servants, and money covering [the expenses of] my Hajj, that of my brother Musa ibn Ubayd, and for Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman – ordering us to make the Hajj on his behalf, so we had a hundred gold coins to be divided up three ways between us. When I wanted to ready the clothes [for the journey] I saw between them some soil, I said to the messenger: what is this? he said: he [the Imam] does not send out any item except that he places in it some soil from the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), then the messenger said: Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: it [the soil] is to provide you safety by the permission of Allah. He also handed us some additional amount to be used to maintain relation with the people of his house and to assist a group who were needy and went un-cared for [in Madina]. He ordered that three hundred gold coins be given to a relation of a woman who was under him [his wife] and ordered me to divorce her on his behalf and provide for her from this amount. He ordered me to make Safwan ibn Yahya and another man – whose name Muhammad ibn Isa forgot – as witnesses to the divorce.

en.summary: This hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam illustrates the practical application of Imam al-Rida’s (AS) authority in managing family affairs and wealth distribution, specifically highlighting the spiritual efficacy of 'Turbah' from Karbala as a divine amulet. The narrative underscores the Imam’s role in facilitating the divorce of a relative through financial settlement (I'til), reflecting the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt's active involvement in social and economic welfare. It serves as a key example of how spiritual merit (thawab) being transferred via Hajj and charitable disbursement, reinforcing the concept of the Imam as the guardian of the community's material and spiritual well-being.
en.seo_question: What is the significance of the soil from the grave of al-Husayn in Shia tradition according to this hadith?

key_terms.صِلَةِ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ: maintaining relations with the people of his house
